dedupe_keys.name: lac ix survey and interactive map of internet exchange points in latin america and the caribbean

description: LAC-IX, the association of internet exchange points of Latin America and the Caribbean based in Montevideo, ran a survey of the exchanges in the region with support from the Internet Society and LACNIC, and published the results as an interactive map and an executive report. The survey asked every exchange declared in the region to fill in a questionnaire, followed up by email, phone and social networks where needed, and identified 98 sites operated by 36 active exchanges. The report covers the context and goal of the survey, its method, a summary of results, a timeline of the growth of exchanges in the region and general conclusions, and LACNIC notes that the data show IPv6 adoption, root servers hosted at exchanges and security measures in place. The executive report, dated August 2022 and covering 2021, is available in English and Spanish, and LAC-IX recommends annual updates. Coverage: Latin America and the Caribbean, survey of 2021. Format and access: interactive web map and PDF reports (19 pages in English), free; LAC-IX reserves all rights. Caveats: self-reported answers; the survey has not visibly been repeated, so figures date from 2021. Simulation uses: inventory of regional interconnection hubs for network flow and hazard exposure models, and a baseline for planning new exchanges. Related records: IX.br traffic statistics cover the largest exchange in the region, and PeeringDB lists exchanges worldwide.
